say:1:1035702001:1.text: Can't you see there's a giant rabbit hole?
say:1:1035702001:1.source_cn: 这么大一个兔子洞，看不出来吗？
say:1:1035702001:1.male: Can't you see there's a giant rabbit hole?
say:1:1035702001:1.female: Can't you see there's a giant rabbit hole?

say:2:1035702002:1.text: As long as I wait here, I can definitely catch a rabbit! It's been days since I've eaten any meat!
say:2:1035702002:1.source_cn: 只要我等得够久，就一定能抓到它！我可是好几天都没吃肉了！

say:4:1035702003:0.text: I don't know, but the rabbit has to come out to forage at some point. That'll be my chance!
say:4:1035702003:0.source_cn: 不知道。但兔子总得出来觅食，等上半天肯定能抓到。

say:5:1035702004:0.text: Also, back off. I found this place first. It's finders-keepers out here. This rabbit is mine.
say:5:1035702004:0.source_cn: 我警告你，这里是我先发现的。谁发现的就归谁——这是盗宝...
